patch_description: Seed the optimization directly with the D6-symmetric Tammes-14 arrangement (two staggered hexagonal rings plus two poles) so the annealed L-BFGS-B pipeline starts at (or extremely near) the known optimum and only needs local polishing. Keep random trials as fallback. Also add a soft-min/soft-max refinement stage matching the actual evaluated objective (dmin/dmax), which is slightly different from pure Tammes on the sphere.
